events.title: Update #1 - Welcome to Rustmourne!
events.summary: Hello and welcome! We just published our Steam page and we wanted to give you some more info about what to expect from Rustmourne. We take inspiration from Dead Space (clearly), Half-Life: Alyx and Doom 3. We are working hard to make a kickass game centered around atmosphere, vibes and tension. The game is a survival horror focused on exploration, stealth and a combat inspired by the strategic dismemberment of Dead Space, combined with Half-Life: Alyx’ immersive, VR-first physicality.
